family.description: QSregVF_b is a family of short Pseudomonas proteins that are potential virulence factors. The structure of UniProtKB:Q9HY15 a secreted protein has been solved and deposited as PDB:3npd, from [pfam:PF13652]. It is predicted that these two adjacent proteins form a single transcriptional unit based on the prediction that together they interact with their adjacent protein PotD, which is the putrescine-binding periplasmic protein in the polyamine uptake system comprising PotABCD. These two adjacent proteins are predicted to be quroum-sensing-regulated virulence factors [[cite:PUB00075641]].
family.name: Putative quorum-sensing-regulated virulence factor
